pages.title: Aire writing desk
pages.content:
Desk

Aire writing desk

A narrow desk for a gap between two windows. One drawer, a fall-front for letters, legs tapered on the inside faces only.

Table

Heptonstall side table

A small table with one drawer and a shaped stretcher, sized to sit beside a chair and hold a lamp, a book and a cup.

posts.title: Reading tables for Todmorden library
posts.excerpt: Eight cherry tables for the reference room, built to outlast the schoolchildren.

posts.title: Twelve Calder chairs for a learning studio
posts.excerpt: A run of twelve chairs in oak, for a gallery education room in Wakefield.
posts.content:
The learning team wanted chairs that children and adults could both use, and that could be stacked two high on a trolley.

We lowered the Calder seat to 430 mm and added a back rail you can grip. The soap finish is the only one that survives poster paint.

Client

The Hepworth Wakefield

Timber

English oak, soap finish

Quantity

12 chairs

Finished

March 2025

posts.title: A writing desk for a flat in Leeds
posts.excerpt: The Aire desk, made 150 mm narrower to fit between two windows.
posts.content:
The client measured the gap between the windows three times before she wrote to us.

The desk is 850 mm wide, in cherry, with one drawer lined in undyed felt. It became the Aire, which is now in the collection.

Client

Private, Chapel Allerton

Timber

Cherry, hardwax oil

Size

850 / 550 / 760 mm

Finished

June 2025

posts.title: The Crag bench, a run of thirty
posts.excerpt: Larch benches for footpaths on the moor above Heptonstall.
posts.content:
Thirty benches in Kielder larch for Pennine Prospects, left unfinished so they weather silver.

Each one has the grid reference of where it sits cut into the end. We carried the last six up the hill on a borrowed quad bike.

Client

Pennine Prospects

Timber

Larch, unfinished

Quantity

30 benches

Finished

September 2023

posts.title: A court cupboard in fumed oak
posts.excerpt: A cupboard for a farmhouse kitchen, darkened with ammonia to match the beams.
posts.content:
A cupboard for a farmhouse kitchen near Heptonstall, where everything else is 300 years old.

Fuming takes two days in a sealed tent in the yard. The oak goes from honey to a deep brown and the carving shows up more than it did when pale.

Client

Private, Heptonstall

Timber

Fumed English oak

Size

1200 / 480 / 1350 mm

Finished

November 2024

posts.title: Rush-seated stools with Felicity Irons
posts.excerpt: We made the frames, Felicity wove the seats from Somerset rush.
posts.content:
Forty stools over one summer.

Felicity cut the rush on the River Ouse and wove the seats in her barn. We made the frames and drove them down to Bedfordshire in two loads.

With

Felicity Irons, rush weaver

Timber

Ash and sycamore

Quantity

40 stools

Finished

July 2022
